column3: Top-left: a cracked seed with two green leaves sprouting up (rebirth). Top-right: two metal dog tags joined by a short chain. Bottom-left: two parallel short swords side by side. Bottom-right: a round-bellied blacksmith bellows with a small flame at its nozzle.

Top-left: a golden censer (incense burner) with a halo ring floating above it. Top-right: a long thin awl made of fire. Bottom-left: a closed suit of ice armour (breastplate). Bottom-right: a small sledgehammer with a wedge stuck in a block of ice.

Top-left: an open hand holding up a single blue water drop. Top-right: a four-leaf clover charm made of silver metal. Bottom-left: a star core bursting outward with cracks. Bottom-right: a roulette wheel with one thick needle pointer.

Top-left: a pinwheel with three blades bent backwards by the wind. Top-right: a battery cell with five small prongs on top, glowing teal. Bottom-left: a teal-cyan faceted dream crystal (a gem). Bottom-right: a small golden ribbon-tied keepsake medal (an heirloom).

Top-left: three diagonal claw scratch marks (a normal fight). Top-right: a horned helmet with two big horns (an elite fight). Bottom-left: a heavy horizontal door bar / bolt across two iron brackets (a gatekeeper). Bottom-right: a three-pointed crown (a boss).

Top-left: a stone basin with water springing up from it (summoning spring). Top-right: a stepped stone pedestal with a small stone floating above it (chaos altar). Bottom-left: a speech bubble with a tail (an event). Bottom-right: a big treasure chest with a lock clasp.

Top-left: a hand offering a sword hilt-first (a borrowed fight). Top-right: an eye opening, with small rays (awakening). Bottom-left: a warning triangle shape made of jagged red-orange crystal (risk), no text. Bottom-right: a dark purple crescent moon with a single closed eye (nightmare difficulty).
